research_question: Is signed visual-representation value localized within pages, and can a deterministic sub-page organization preserve useful retrieval evidence while reducing cross-query interference at an acceptable physical cost?
scope: Diagnostic headroom audit, not a deployable materialization policy.

cohort.positive_order: descending singleton net mean nDCG delta
cohort.negative_order: ascending singleton net mean nDCG delta
cohort.warning: The cohort intentionally uses oracle page-value labels to diagnose granularity. Labels are forbidden to the eventual compiler.

xycut_regions.role: deterministic structure-aware region proposal without learned layout labels

retrieval.region_to_parent_aggregation: maximum region score per parent page
retrieval.eligible_queries: queries with at least one relevant parent in the frozen cohort

interpretation_gate.region_headroom: At least one sub-page organization must preserve at least 95% of whole-page eligible-query nDCG while reducing negative-page irrelevant top-10 exposure by at least 10%.
interpretation_gate.physical_efficiency: Report build seconds and bytes per parent. A region organization that improves quality but increases both cost measures is evidence for localization, not yet an index optimization.
interpretation_gate.stop_condition: If neither fixed nor structure-aware regions improve the signed benefit-interference trade-off in either domain, retain page as the current visual unit and shift effort to cross-modal logical organization rather than finer visual crops.

information_boundary.future_use: Any method chosen after this audit requires a new-domain blind test.
information_boundary.qrels: Used only for diagnostic evaluation and cohort interpretation.
